By the way, it's not just the food that is good at Hanh & Ken. The owner and everyone who works here are super nice people who all clearly enjoy their work. Culinary heaven
Oct 2023 • Solo
A Must place to eat when in Da Dang ! 
Ken, the Maitre'D is a regular Johnny Carson. 
Many interesting people dine here.

I met Jacques, a French underwear explorer who had amazing stories to tell about his adventures down under

The food is top class too and very affordable. 
Very pretty staff also (apart from Ken)

Big generous helpings of food. When i was leaving, they were chasing me down the street with gift baskets of steaming broccoli and spring rolls. Barely got the taxi door shut. You don't get that kind of love no more

Definitely going back
